name: Kweather Co., Ltd.
summary: Kweather Co., Ltd., founded in 1966 in Seoul, South Korea, initially as the Korea Weather Association before its name change in July 1977, delivers a comprehensive array of meteorological and associated services. The company caters to mass media outlets, diverse industries, and both private and public sector organizations throughout South Korea. Its offerings include critical weather intelligence such as detailed content, long-range predictions, direct forecaster access, weather-related insurance, and advanced solutions for industrial weather risk management. Mobile services comprise weather SMS alerts, clock screen integrations, and data broadcasting. Kweather is also a leading supplier of sophisticated upper-air meteorological technology, providing instruments like weather radars, wind profilers, GPS radiosonde systems, microwave radiometers, weather satellite systems, LIDAR remote sensors, and WINDCUBE devices for precise lower-atmosphere wind assessment. Furthermore, the company develops and deploys extensive meteorological observation systems, including various sensors, automatic weather stations (specialized for general use, snow depth, road conditions, and maritime environments), automated surface observing systems, and portable weather stations. It also conducts detailed weather element analysis for environmental evaluations. For individual consumers, Kweather operates an online store offering household weather products, such as temperature/humidity monitors, leisure and health gadgets, and environmental measurement devices.
